black_rose.name: The Bomber Sherpa

black_rose.identity: The exact same male performer from the founder-supplied original bomber footage MUST appear in every Black Rose shot. Use unchanged source frames 731 and 1427 as explicit actor references for every new image and motion job, independently of the fixed Skyy identity reference.
black_rose.source_review: Founder confirms the actual garment in the footage. Current card/physical product and archive Skyy bomber have been visually inspected. Before generating new mascot scenes, reconcile emblem, placket and pocket details against this garment evidence. Archive background is not scene authority.
black_rose.primary_garment_evidence: Founder-supplied video depicts the actual Black Rose Sherpa Bomber (br-006), explicitly confirmed in this conversation. Use the footage for the actual garment's appearance and movement; retain product-card and physical-product references for construction details.

global.commercial_feel: Hook, encounter, discovery and product payoff in every film; clear garments immediately, one large reveal that changes the scale or meaning of the scene.
global.train: The train connects each collection story. Short, full-screen excerpts of the actual Black Rose garment interrupt and resolve the model/Skyy encounter while the train scenes establish narrative continuity.
global.wordless: No dialogue, voiceover, captions, titles or added signage. Selected source footage is silent, with all selected frames visually unchanged.
global.hero: One recognizable source-derived hero feature anchors each world; don't import source hero cast or change garment marks.
global.delivery: Four20.020-second standalone films and one40.040-second main commercial are rendered.720x1280 at24000/1001fps, silent. Lossless masters and H264 viewing copies are separate exports.
global.ending: Kids ends with shared recognition and Skyy offering a low open palm to the viewer beside the real red-outfit child. This supersedes the earlier child-led invitation reversal.

films.title: The First Light
films.story: The adult and Skyy notice their matching sherpas. An offered hand and small nod become an invitation. A foreground train rib passes across the camera view before the monumental gold rose and bridge appear beyond the window.

beats.action: Open on the source model's red rose and white-lined black jacket, with his face already readable.
A restrained reframing reveals Skyy beside the adjacent window wearing the corrected matching Sherpa.
He opens a hand toward the window place; Skyy looks from the shared chest roses toward the glass.
The last dark bridge beam slides past. The panoramic window reveals the monumental gold rose and source metallic curve at scale, with a believable distant landscape.
Hold both matching jacket fronts in warm neutral light. Skyy and the model exchange a quiet nod.

films.reveal: An intimate shared garment detail expands into the full gold hero sculpture seen from the train.
films.master_select: Matching glance plus gold reveal from newly created shots.

films.title: The Night Car
films.story: Open on the actual bomber in the supplied footage. Cut to the same man meeting Skyy in the matching bomber aboard the night carriage. Their glance motivates short source inserts showing the garment front and rear rose. Return to their encounter, then to the real bomber's front as its fabric catches light. The train clears the bridge structure and reveals the monumental silver rose. Product recognition drives the story from the first image to the final paired look.

beats.action: Actual source front: establish the performer, black satin bomber, chest rose and construction before introducing the stylized world.
New train encounter: the same performer notices Skyy's matching bomber. Keep both fronts clear and the monument hidden.
Actual source inserts: one second of the remaining front selection, followed by two seconds of the rear rose and bomber shape.
New train reaction: their eye line connects; the final bridge rib still withholds the outside landmark.
Actual source front: hold the real garment and fabric movement for three seconds.
New large reveal: bridge structure clears the window, exposing the source black star and silver rose, with the matching bomber pair in the foreground.
New payoff: the man and Skyy exchange a small nod; garment fronts own the last image.

films.reveal: The actual garment's rose detail connects to Skyy's matching look and the source monument. Hold front views before and after the rear detail so the jacket remains unmistakable.
films.master_select: Approximately 12-second main-film chapter: 6 seconds of actual garment excerpts and 6 seconds of new encounter/reveal footage. Full-source inclusion is no longer required.

product_readability.rule: Every source insert shows the actual bomber at its existing full-frame scale. Keep the front and chest mark visible; rear graphic adds detail after the garment is established.

films.title: The Seat Beside You
films.story: The seated model and standing Skyy recognize their matching bombers. He opens a hand toward the empty seat; camera movement reveals the thorned arch, cloche rose and exterior red star.

beats.action: Readable white/black bomber front beside an empty window place; red surroundings do not tint the white garment.
Skyy appears at the internal doorway; one accepting look, exact jacket details and separate identities.
The model offers the seat with a single open hand. Cut rather than generate a complicated sit-down.
Wider composition with the adult remaining seated reveals the hero's pointed arch and fixed cloche rose through aligned carriage doorways.
Matching jacket fronts and exchanged glance hold the final product image.

films.reveal: Depth through successive arches reveals the cloche rose; the empty place gains emotional meaning.

films.title: Your Turn
films.story: Opaque train doors open onto the matching red pair and crown-backed throne. A separate cut introduces the purple child and matching Skyy. Return to the red pair for shared recognition and Skyy inviting the viewer.

beats.action: Opaque doors open mechanically onto the red pair.
Camera retreats to reveal throne; pair exchange looks and face the viewer.
Separate purple pair, exact alternate child identity.
Red pair returns; Skyy offers a low open palm toward the viewer beside the smiling child.

films.reveal: Withheld doorway opens into an entire observation carriage built around the throne. The final invitation reverses the adult-led beginning.
films.master_select: Door reveal, both complete Kids colorways and invitation reversal; Kids ends the main commercial.
